Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its reasoning. While it correctly identified that the Livesey Hall War Memorial commemorates both World War I and World War II, it incorrectly stated that "World War I is the conflict typically cited as having over 60 million casualties." In reality, World War II is the conflict associated with over 60 million casualties (estimates range from 70 to 85 million), whereas World War I had approximately 20 million casualties. Because the Planner relied on this false premise to conclude the answer was World War I, it failed to solve the problem correctly.
